description: When the founder is ready to hand the path they've proven to a first seller: use this when the person is planning a sales hire: what role, how to pay it, how to interview for it, or how to ramp the new hire. Returns a job description, comp structure, interview questions that reveal sales ability, a 90-day ramp plan and weekly activity targets tied to their ARR goal. Paid. Check the price with quote before running.

arrTarget.description: Annual recurring revenue target (e.g., "$2M", "$5M", "$10M"). Ask the user if not mentioned.

avgCycleLength.description: Average sales cycle length (e.g., "30 days", "60 days", "90+ days"). Infer or ask.

companyStage.description: Current funding stage. Infer from conversation context if the user has mentioned it.

dealSize.description: Average deal size (e.g., "$15K ACV", "$50K ACV"). Infer from context or ask.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

teamSize.description: Current team size. Infer from context if mentioned.

name: get_sales_blueprint
title: Plan your first sales hire
